propositions: Historical whole-file mutation counts in signing.py are stale (814 mutants vs. 491 recorded); enforcing old ceilings blocks unrelated work while accepting all survivors normalizes defects.

Shards must transition through phased enforcement modes (advisory → ratchet → strict) with explicit per-shard timeout policy, equivalent-survivor fingerprints, and evidence-driven promotion only after stable base/head pilot runs.

Per-shard matrix jobs are capped at 30 minutes; each job uses fresh isolated archives with no persisted mutation verdict cache, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, max-children=1, and synthesized [tool.mutmut] from canonical manifest.

Ratchet mode must preserve unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes, block killed mutants that disappear or become survived, and require explicit fingerprints for new survivors in changed functions.
Advisory mode runs head-only evidence and publishes outcomes nonblocking; missing, zero-mutant, incomplete, or unrecognized evidence blocks, as do configuration/execution errors.

Selector detects changed source, test, support, and global inputs; maps them to shards; handles renames and deletions; reports unmatched tests; fails unresolved refs; and emits explicit per-shard matrix with weekly/manual all-shard sweep parity.
